Asset type: production transparent combat sprite atlas for a Chinese gothic fantasy 2.5D action RPG.
Create ONE atlas showing exactly THREE full-body poses of the SAME single character, horizontally arranged in three equal-width cells: LEFT combat ready idle, CENTER unmistakable attack anticipation / weapon drawn back, RIGHT decisive attack follow-through. All three look toward camera-right in three-quarter view, slightly seen from above at 15 degrees. Consistent identity, clothes, equipment, anatomy and proportions in all three. Whole figure and whole weapon visible in each cell with generous transparent margins, same foot baseline at 88 percent canvas height. Never overlap cells. Center each figure at one-sixth, one-half and five-sixths canvas width. Choose a wide landscape canvas about 3:2; cells are tall and separate. No cell frames, no words, no labels, no grids.
Style: polished hand-painted Japanese dark-fantasy game character sprites, detailed restrained linework, readable silhouette, muted fabrics and metal, soft neutral key light with very subtle cool rim. Match the project's richly dressed illustrated characters rather than chibi pixel art. Isolated actual transparent RGBA background, not white, not checkerboard painted in image, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no scenery. NO baked glowing attack arcs, NO spell explosions, NO floating text. Weapon movement is in the pose itself.

His weapon is a short ceremonial execution sword and a heavy chain clasp. Regal official, not a monster, not a bell priest.
Animation design: idle poised and balanced; anticipation visibly leans back with weapon raised, charge or spell prepared; follow-through leans forward with weapon extended. For quadrupeds: idle crouch, hind legs loaded, then forelegs extending into a grounded lunge. Keep same camera and readable limb count. Do not crop feet or blade tips. Each pose is one character only.
Input image is IDENTITY reference only: use the specifically named person from the six-person contact sheet. Do not draw the sheet or any of the other five people.
